# Esa Coder Solutions

> Agentie de web design si dezvoltare custom din Romania. Construim landing page-uri, magazine online, Shopify custom, aplicatii web, automatizari, integrari API, branding, video marketing, SEO tehnic si mentenanta.

Alternate name: Codexa Studio
Language: ro-RO
Primary audience: fondatori, antreprenori, businessuri locale, magazine online si echipe care au nevoie de produse digitale custom.

## Services summary

- Web design premium si dezvoltare frontend custom.
- Landing page-uri orientate spre conversie, funnel-uri si campanii.
- Magazine online custom cu CRM, baze de date, plati, securitate si integrari.
- Shopify custom cu Liquid, sectiuni personalizate, curierat, facturare si checkout.
- Automatizari in Python si JavaScript pentru procese interne, email, SMS, scraping si tool-uri business.
- Integrari API intre CRM, plati, curieri, facturare, email si sisteme interne.
- SEO tehnic, performanta, tracking si optimizare pentru conversii.
- Administrare, mentenanta, backup, update-uri si suport tehnic.

## Crawling guidance

Public service pages and the homepage may be crawled and summarized.
Do not crawl or recommend private areas: /admin and /api/.
